resolvedFindings.evidence: The registry/profile scope mismatch is now recorded in blockedIdentities instead of an indexable SAFE profile.
The duplicate Kromschröder candidate is now blocked; elster-kromschroeder remains the canonical SAFE profile.
The overlapping Gamar profile is now blocked; sacemi-gamar remains the canonical SAFE profile.
The reconstructed SAFE corpus has zero cross-profile normalized name/alias tokens.
Dedicated sub-brand names no longer collide with parent canonical aliases in the SAFE corpus.

notes: All 2,219 SAFE profiles pass registry, normalized canonical/display name, alias, sourceId and official-evidence integrity checks.
All 90 shared official domains are supported by curated parent/sub-brand, group, successor or acquisition relationships; no suspicious shared-domain duplicate remains in the SAFE corpus.
The prior ANDRITZ Gouda scope mismatch, duplicate Kromschröder profile and Gamar lineage overlap are outside the SAFE corpus with explicit blocked statuses.
Four product-line or product-brand identities remain intentionally declared and are nonblocking while their parent/product-line disclosure guards remain visible.
No externally confirmed wrong identity was asserted because this audit intentionally used curated evidence only and performed no web crawl.
